name: Semimaru
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 10); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: The stranger who has travelled far
poems.author: Semimaru
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 10
poems.text:
The stranger who has travelled far,
The friend with welcome smile,
All sorts of men who come and go
Meet at this mountain stile,—
They meet and rest awhile.
